Simply use <nowiki>{{</nowiki>[[Template:Factual|factual]]<nowiki>|</nowiki>any factual information here<nowiki>}}</nowiki>.  This template can take extended formatting.

==Example==
<pre>
{{Factual|This is an example of the factual template in use.
* You can use wiki markup just fine in this template.
* Including bullets, '''bold''' text, ''italic'' text, and other things.
* Links are the same, [[cv:dwarf|dwarfiness]] for example.
# Oh man, we need a numbered list now.
#* With a sub list.
#* hopefully this makes sense.
#* If it doesn't, well, we may have problems.
# But it works, so we're fine.
<br /> Even HTML linebreaks work.
Cool beans.
}}
</pre>
